mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.balance, u.frozen_balance, u.used_balance, u.request_count, u.billing_multiplier, u.billing_preference, u.ai_concurrency_limit, u.active_request_count, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.pwd_update_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select:
select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope}
select user_id, status, balance, frozen_balance, used_balance, request_count, billing_multiplier, billing_preference, ai_concurrency_limit from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} for update

select user_id, status, balance, frozen_balance, used_balance, request_count, billing_multiplier, billing_preference, ai_concurrency_limit, active_request_count from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}
select user_id, user_name from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user( user_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, email, avatar, phonenumber, sex, password, status, balance, used_balance, request_count, billing_multiplier, billing_preference, pwd_update_date, create_by, remark, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{phonenumber}, #{sex}, #{password}, #{status}, #{balance}, #{usedBalance}, #{requestCount}, #{billingMultiplier}, #{billingPreference}, #{pwdUpdateDate}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_user set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set billing_multiplier = #{billingMultiplier}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'

update sys_user set balance = balance - #{cost}, used_balance = used_balance + #{cost}, request_count = request_count + 1, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and balance - frozen_balance >= #{cost}
update sys_user set used_balance = used_balance + #{cost}, request_count = request_count + 1, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set balance = balance + #{amount}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set balance = #{balance}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and #{balance} >= frozen_balance
update sys_user set billing_preference = #{billingPreference}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set ai_concurrency_limit = #{aiConcurrencyLimit}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
update sys_user set active_request_count = active_request_count + 1, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and active_request_count < ai_concurrency_limit
update sys_user set active_request_count = active_request_count - 1, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and active_request_count > 0
update sys_user set avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set login_ip = #{loginIp}, login_date = #{loginDate} where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set pwd_update_date = sysdate(), password = #{password}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: update sys_user set del_flag = '2' where user_id = #{userId}
